newsitem.title: USA: Innovo stockholders rejects stock option plan.
newsitem.headline: Innovo stockholders rejects stock option plan.

text.p: Innovo Group Inc said on Friday that its shareholders approved an increase in the number of authorized shares, but did not approve a new class of preferred stock or a new stock option plan.

The preferred stock and stock option plan did not receive the required approval of over one-half o the total outstanding shares due to the large number of shares that were not voted on these proposals, Innovo said.
Innovo's shareholders approved an increase in the number of authorized common shares to 70 million. The present number of authorized shares was not immediately available.
